[P1] 北京市绿色印刷工程
优秀少儿读物绿色印刷示范项目
儿童情绪管理与性格培养绘本
第二辑 我不再害怕
不再害怕 尝试
When Lizzy Was Afraid of Trying New Things
[美] 苏格·迈尔（Sue Mayer） 著
[美] 詹妮弗·坎顿（Jennifer Canton） 绘
孙燕 译
美国心理学会
官方授权
APA
化学工业出版社

[P2] 不再害怕尝试
When Lizzy Was Afraid of
Trying New Things
[美] 英格·迈尔（Inger Maier） 著
[美] 詹妮弗·坎顿（Jennifer Candon） 绘
孙燕 译


化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P3] 富丝、爸爸和妈妈，还有他的双胞胎
弟妹碧丝和丽丝，一起住在一个又大又绿
的田野上。
富丝喜欢当大哥哥。作为老大，他有时
帮其他羊分辨双胞胎中谁是谁。碧丝的
外衣上有一个“之”字形的条纹，丽丝背
上有一个棕色的圈圈。

[P4] 这对双胞胎还有其他的不同。
丽丝非常非常害羞，她总是害怕尝试
新东西。
丽丝甚至不愿意和富丝、碧丝一起玩
好玩的游戏。
没有人知道为什么，看上去丽丝天生
就是这样子的。
得分
富丝6
碧丝4

[P5] “来，我们一起围着大石头赛跑吧。”富丝叫道。
“我跑得不够快呀。”丽丝说。
“我们一起和小山羊杠杠玩传球吧。”碧丝大喊。
“不，他会撞到我的。”丽丝回答。
她心里说：“也许我会哭的，然后所有人都会看我的。”

[P6] 当弯弯表哥来到这边田野的时候，丽丝总是藏在花丛中，眼睛紧紧闭着。她想，这样弯弯表哥就不会看到她了。“弯弯表哥又大又聪明，”丽丝对自己说，“如果我做错了什么事，他会笑话我的。”

爸爸和妈妈很担心。丽丝不玩，也不和富丝、碧丝一起去探险，她和小羊朋友在一起玩的也不多。

[P7] 有一天，富丝非常激动。
“我有一个好主意！”他大喊。
爸爸和妈妈听了富丝的主意，点头答应了。
“开家庭会议了！”爸爸吹响了他的大羊号，招呼大家。

“丽丝，我有一个好玩的新游戏，”富丝说，“而且非常简单！每次当你尝试一件新事情的时候，碧丝和我就会在这片草丛边放一块小石头。这样，当你看到这个石头堆的时候，就知道你尝试过多少种不同的事情了。”

[P8] 对于这是不是个好主意，丽丝有点拿不准。
“这件事要是太难了怎么办？”她问。
“那你可以先尝试容易的。”妈妈说。
“我要是做得不好怎么办？”
“没关系。你要做的只是去试。”爸爸说。
“你还是会得到石头的。”富丝说。
丽丝开始感觉好一些了。

“我用三条腿站着算不算？”
“当然了。”富丝说。
丽丝抬起一条腿，她开始觉得有点不稳当，不过她并没有摔倒。
“这不太难。”她说。
富丝和碧丝去找石头，把石头滚到草丛边。

[P9] 下一次，丽丝摘下了一朵蒲公英。
然后她慢慢地深吸一口气，把蒲公英
绒球吹散。小种子们飞散在空中，就像小
星星。
这件事值两块石头。
丽丝注意到，当她慢慢吸气和呼气的
时候，她感觉更平静了。
“我喜欢这样！”丽丝说。

[P10] “我做到了！我做到了！”丽丝跳过小河，兴高采烈地喊，“石头堆上再来一块！”
妈妈和爸爸也为她欢呼。
丽丝看到弯弯表哥在看她。
“我能试着打个招呼，”她对自己说，“我可以试试，这样我可以再得到一块石头。”
让弯弯惊讶的是，这回丽丝没有躲起来。
“嗨！弯弯！我们一起玩吧！”丽丝说。

[P11] 丽丝和其他小羊一起围着田地里的大石头赛跑。
“我赢啦！我赢啦！”她说。
丽丝开始觉得，她跑得快不快并不要紧，
只要在玩就很开心。
又有一天，丽丝把她的两只后蹄搭在苹果树上，就像小山羊杠杠做的那样。
富丝也想试一试，可他摔倒了。
“看，丽丝，你能做那么多事情了。”富丝笑着说。

[P12] 现在，那堆石头越来越高了。
每天丽丝都骄傲地看看它们。
“看我尝试了多少事情！”她想，“而且
多数事情都很好玩。”

[P13] 有时丽丝还是会感觉害怕。
当她到山坡滑草的时候，她的小心脏
跳得又快又猛烈。但她想起，她曾经在这
里吹过蒲公英，心里就平静多了。于是，
她想象自己手里拿着一朵蒲公英，要把它
的种子吹到空中去。她慢慢地吸气、呼气。
“一点一点，一点一点，我就能做到。”
她轻轻地說。
丽丝先从山脚下开始滑，一次比一次
更高一点。

[P14] 妈妈和爸爸
看到石头堆越
来越高了，丽
丝也不再胆小
害羞了，他们
很高兴。每当
丽丝尝试新事
情时，他们都
为她感到骄傲。

晚饭时爸
爸对丽丝说：
“我们要用那
堆石头做点特
别的事情。”

那天晚上，当
所有的小羊都熟睡
之后，妈妈和爸爸
挖了一个大圆坑，
然后他们小心地用
蹄子和鼻子搬哪，
堆呀，用那些石头
给圆坑搭了一圈石
头墙。

然后，天开
始下雨了。
雨下了又
下，下了又下。

[P15] “丽丝！看看你的石头都到哪儿去了！”第二天，富丝和碧丝醒来后大喊。
丽丝兴奋地笑了，给了妈妈和爸爸一人一个大大的拥抱。
然后她和哥哥们一起奔向这个新水坑。
扑通！

No Longer Afraid to Try
When Lizzy Was Afraid of Trying New Things
[USA] Sue Mayer (Sue Mayer) Author

[P2] No Longer Afraid of Trying
When Lizzy Was Afraid of

[US] Inger Maier (Inger Maier) Author

Sun Yan Translator

[P3] Fusi, his dad and mom, and his twin siblings
Bisi and Lisi, live together on a big, green
field.
Fusi likes being the big brother. As the oldest,
he sometimes helps other sheep tell the twins apart. Bisi
has a zigzag stripe on her coat, and Lisi has
a brown circle on her back.

[P4] These twins were different in other ways.
Lizzy was very, very shy. She was always afraid to try
new things.
Lizzy didn't even want to play fun games with Fuzzy and Bissy.
No one knew why. It seemed like Lizzy was born
this way.
Score
Fuzzy 6
Bissy 4

[P5] "Come on, let's race around the big rock!" Fusi called out.
"I'm not fast enough," Lisi said.
"Let's play catch with Little Goat Ganggang!" Bisi shouted.
"No, he'll bump into me," Lisi replied.
She thought to herself, "Maybe I'll cry, and then everyone will look at me."

[P6] When Cousin Bendy came to this field, Lizzie always hid in the flowers, her eyes tightly shut. She thought, this way Cousin Bendy wouldn’t see her. “Cousin Bendy is big and smart,” Lizzie told herself, “if I do something wrong, he’ll laugh at me.”

Dad and Mom were worried. Lizzie didn’t play, nor did she go on adventures with Fusi and Bisi. She didn’t play much with her lamb friends either.

[P7] One day, Fusi was very excited.
"I have a great idea!" he shouted.
Dad and Mom listened to Fusi's idea and nodded in agreement.
"Family meeting time!" Dad blew his big sheep horn to call everyone.

"Lisi, I have a fun new game," Fusi said, "and it's very simple! Every time you try something new, Bisi and I will place a small stone by this bush. That way, when you see this pile of stones, you'll know how many different things you've tried."

[P8] Lis was unsure if this was a good idea.
"What if this is too hard?" she asked.
"You can start with something easy," said Mom.
"What if I don't do it well?"
"It's okay. All you need to do is try," said Dad.
"You'll still get a stone," said Fusi.
Lis began to feel better.

"Does standing on three legs count?"
"Of course," said Fusi.
Lis lifted one leg. She felt a bit unsteady, but she didn't fall.
"This isn't too hard," she said.
Fusi and Bisi went to find a stone and rolled it to the edge of the grass.

[P9] Next, Lisi picked a dandelion.
Then she slowly took a deep breath and blew the dandelion fluff apart. The tiny seeds floated through the air, like little stars.
This was worth two stones.
Lisi noticed that when she slowly inhaled and exhaled, she felt calmer.
"I like this!" Lisi said.

[P10] "I did it! I did it!" Lisi jumped over the little river, shouting excitedly, "One more stone on the pile!"
Mom and Dad cheered for her too.
Lisi saw her cousin Wanwan watching her.
"I can try saying hello," she said to herself, "I can give it a try, and then I can get another stone."
To Wanwan's surprise, this time Lisi didn't hide.
"Hi, Wanwan! Let's play together!" Lisi said.

[P11] Lisi and the other lambs raced around the big stone in the field.
"I won! I won!" she said.
Lisi began to feel that it didn't matter how fast she ran,
as long as she was having fun.
Another day, Lisi put her two hind legs on the apple tree, just like little goat Ganggang did.
Fusi wanted to try too, but he fell down.
"Look, Lisi, you can do so many things now," Fusi said with a smile.

[P12] Now, the pile of stones was getting taller and taller.
Every day, Lisi proudly looked at them.
"Look at how many things I've tried!" she thought, "And most of them are really fun."

[P13] Sometimes Lisi still felt afraid.
When she went sledding down the hill, her little heart
beat fast and hard. But she remembered that she had once
blown dandelions here, and her mind became much calmer. So,
she imagined holding a dandelion in her hand, blowing its
seeds into the air. She slowly inhaled and exhaled.
"Little by little, little by little, I can do it," she said softly.
Lisi started sliding from the bottom of the hill, higher and higher each time.

[P14] Mom and Dad
saw the pile of stones getting
higher and higher. Lisi was no longer
shy or timid, and they were very happy.
Every time Lisi tried something new,
they felt proud of her.

At dinner, Dad
said to Lisi:
"We're going to do something
special with that pile of stones."

That night, after
all the little lambs were asleep,
Mom and Dad dug a big round hole.
Then they carefully used
their hooves and noses to move,
stack, and build a stone wall
around the hole.

Then, it started
raining.
The rain fell and fell,
and fell again.

[P15] "Lisi! Look where your stones have gone!" The next day, Fusi and Bisi woke up and shouted.
Lisi laughed excitedly and gave Mom and Dad each a big hug.
Then she ran toward the new puddle with her brothers.
Splash!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《不再害怕尝试》，讲述小羊Lizzy害怕尝试新事物的故事，由美国心理学会官方授权，旨在帮助儿童进行情绪管理和性格培养。
[P2] 本页为绘本《不再害怕尝试》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，并配有一只小羊站在草地上仰望太阳的插图。
[P3] 本页介绍了小羊富丝和他的家人，包括父母及双胞胎弟妹碧丝和丽丝，他们住在一片大而绿的田野上，并说明了富丝作为老大喜欢帮助分辨双胞胎，以及碧丝和丽丝各自的外貌特征。
[P4] 本页描述了双胞胎丽丝的害羞性格，她害怕尝试新事物，甚至不愿和兄弟姐妹一起玩游戏，插图展示了三只小羊在草地上玩耍的场景，并附有游戏得分牌。
[P5] 本页展示了小羊丽丝因害怕失败和被关注而拒绝参与赛跑和传球游戏，表现出她对新活动的恐惧心理。
[P6] 丽丝因害怕被表哥笑话而躲在花丛中，父母担心她不愿参与游戏和探险，社交活动很少。
[P7] 富丝想出了一个鼓励丽丝尝试新事物的游戏，提议每次丽丝尝试新事物时，就放一块石头在草丛边，以此记录她的尝试次数，并召集家人开会讨论这个主意。
[P8] 丽丝在家人鼓励下，开始尝试富丝提出的‘尝试新事物’游戏，她尝试用三条腿站立并成功，感到信心增强，随后富丝和碧丝去寻找石头作为奖励。
[P9] 丽丝尝试吹散蒲公英，通过深呼吸感到平静，并因这次尝试获得两块石头作为奖励，她表示喜欢这个活动。
[P10] 丽丝成功跳过小河，获得奖励石头，并鼓起勇气主动向表哥弯弯打招呼，邀请他一起玩，表现出她克服恐惧、积极参与社交的转变。
[P11] 丽丝和同伴们一起赛跑并感到快乐，随后她尝试将后蹄搭在苹果树上，富丝也尝试但摔倒了，富丝鼓励丽丝，称赞她能做很多事情。
[P12] 丽丝看着自己因尝试新事物而积累的石头堆，感到自豪，并意识到大多数尝试都很有趣。
[P13] 丽丝在山坡滑草时感到害怕，她通过回忆吹蒲公英的经历，用深呼吸平静自己，并逐渐尝试从更低处滑向更高处。
[P14] 丽丝因尝试新事物积累的石头堆越来越高，父母为她感到骄傲。晚饭时爸爸提议用石头做点特别的事，当晚父母用石头围起一个圆坑，随后天下起了大雨。
[P15] 第二天，富丝和碧丝发现丽丝的石头不见了，丽丝兴奋地拥抱父母后，和哥哥们一起奔向由石头围成的新水坑，跳了进去。
[P16] 画面中一只小羊站在草地上，背景是太阳和蝴蝶，场景宁静美好，暗示丽丝和家人在雨后享受新水坑带来的快乐时光。
